soruGiris: Bunlar öğretmeninin kâğıdındaki sorular, kâğıttaki sırayla. Kâğıtta ne yapacaksan burada da onu yap: metni oku, tam cümleyle yaz, kelimeleri kutulara yerleştir.
giris: Öğretmeninin kâğıdındaki 5 bölüm sınavda çıkacak. Önce 5 konu kartını oku ve boşlukları doldur. Sonra soruları sırayla çöz. En sonda Kısa Cevap Kartları ile her cevabı bir kez daha hatırla. Cevapları hep tam cümleyle yaz: “Sam.” değil, “Sam is older than Jane.”
puanNotu: Kâğıttaki puanlar: Part B 24, Part C 20, Part D 20, Part E 21. Tablo sorusunun puanı yazmıyor.
kaynakNotu: Sorular öğretmenin kâğıdından. Cevaplar metinlerden ve tablodan; tam cümle kalıpları ve sıklık zarfları Own it! 3 WB s. 86 (adverbs of frequency).

kazanimlar.ad: Tablodaki bilgileri karşılaştırma sıfatlarıyla tam cümle yazar.

maddeler: Tablo: Jane 12 yaş, 58 kg, 1.52 m · Sam 13 yaş, 62 kg, 1.65 m.
Age (yaş) büyük → older · Height (boy) büyük → taller · Weight (kilo) büyük → heavier.
Cevap kalıbı: İsim + is + sıfat-er + than + diğeri.
1. Sam is older than Jane. 2. Sam is taller than Jane. 3. Sam is heavier than Jane.
heavy → y düşer, -ier: heavier. Tersi: younger, shorter, lighter.

hatalar.dogru: Sam is older than Jane. (tam cümle)

tekrar.c: “Look at the table and answer the questions.” = Tabloya bak ve {soruları cevapla|tabloyu çiz}.
“Who is older, Jane or Sam?” = Jane mi Sam mi daha {yaşlı (büyük)|uzun|kilolu}?
Sam 13, Jane 12 → {Sam|Jane} is older than {Jane|Sam}.
1.65 m > 1.52 m → Sam is {taller|shorter} than Jane.
62 kg > 58 kg → Sam is {heavier|heavyer|lighter} than Jane.
Tam cümle: {Sam is older than Jane.|Sam.|Older.}

kazanimlar.ad: Okuduğu metindeki kişilerin görünüşünü ve kişiliğini tam cümleyle anlatır.
maddeler: Soru kalıpları: Who is …? → “Harry is …” · Is Sam …? → “Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.”
What does Harry look like? = görünüşü (saç, göz, boy) · What is Sam like? = kişiliği (nasıl biri).
Sam (anlatan): short, plump, dark wavy hair, brown eyes · shy, nervous, punctual, generous, kind · always on time.
Harry (kardeşi): younger, a little taller, curly blond hair, green eyes, well-built · lots of friends → outgoing and social · not punctual.
Cevaplar: 1 Sam is shorter than Harry. 2 He is well-built with curly blond hair and green eyes. 3 Harry is outgoing and social.
4 Yes, he is. 5 He is shy, nervous, punctual, generous and kind. 6 Sam is older than Harry.

hatalar.yanlis: What is Sam like? → He is short and plump.
hatalar.dogru: “like” = kişilik → He is shy, nervous, punctual, generous and kind.

hatalar.yanlis: Who is shorter? → Harry is shorter.
hatalar.dogru: Harry is a little taller than me (Sam) → Sam is shorter than Harry.

hatalar.yanlis: Is Sam a punctual person? → Yes.

tekrar.c: “Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.” = Metni oku, soruları {tam cümlelerle|tek kelimeyle} cevapla.
“What does Harry look like?” = Harry'nin {görünüşü nasıl|kişiliği nasıl}? “What is Sam like?” = Sam {nasıl biri (kişilik)|neye benziyor}?
“He is a little taller than me.” (Harry) → {Sam|Harry} is shorter. “He is younger than me.” → {Sam|Harry} is older.
Harry: {curly blond|dark wavy} hair, {green|brown} eyes, {well-built|plump}.
Harry has a lot of friends → Harry is {outgoing and social|shy and nervous}.
Sam: “I am always on time.” → Is Sam a punctual person? {Yes, he is.|No, he isn't.}
What is Sam like? → He is shy, nervous, {punctual|plump}, generous and {kind|tall}.

kazanimlar.ad: Okuduğu metindeki kişilerin kişiliğini tam cümleyle anlatır.
kazanimlar.kisa: Part C: Ellie, Jenny, Jeremy, Rosa
maddeler: Ellie: fikrini kolay değiştirmez → stubborn; ama respectful and kind.
Jenny: open-minded, always tells the truth, hates lies → honest.
Jeremy: studies hard, high marks → çalışkan (hardworking), lazy değil.
Rosa = metni anlatan (“Me? I am Rosa.”): eşyaları düşürüp kırar → clumsy (sakar); “Thank you / Sorry” der → kibar.
Cevaplar: 1 She is stubborn, respectful and kind. 2 Jenny is honest and never tells lies. 3 No, he isn't.
4 Rosa is clumsy. 5 Yes, they are. (iki kişi → they)

hatalar.yanlis: Who is clumsy? → Jeremy is clumsy.
hatalar.dogru: Rosa (anlatan) eşyaları düşürüp kırıyor → Rosa is clumsy.

hatalar.yanlis: Is Jeremy a lazy person? → Yes, he is.
hatalar.dogru: Jeremy studies hard → No, he isn't.

hatalar.yanlis: Are Ellie and Rosa kind people? → Yes, she is.

tekrar.c: “Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.” = Metni oku, soruları {tam cümlelerle|kısaca} cevapla.
“Is Jeremy a lazy person?” = Jeremy {tembel biri mi|çalışkan biri mi}?
Ellie doesn't change her mind easily → She is {stubborn|honest|clumsy}, respectful and kind.
Jenny always tells the truth → {Jenny|Ellie} is honest and never tells lies.
Jeremy studies hard → Is Jeremy lazy? {No, he isn't.|Yes, he is.}
“Me? I am Rosa. I always drop and break things.” → {Rosa|Jeremy} is clumsy.
Are Ellie and Rosa kind people? → Yes, {they are|she is|he is}.

kazanimlar.ad: Sporları bireysel ve takım sporları olarak gruplar.
maddeler: Individual sports (tek başına): running, archery, golf, karate, swimming, wrestling.
Team sports (takımla): football, basketball, handball, ice-hockey, baseball.
Ayırma yolu: Takım arkadaşın var mı? Varsa team, yoksa individual.
Soru 2 + 2 istiyor; en kolayları: swimming, running · football, basketball.
archery = okçuluk · wrestling = güreş · ice-hockey = buz hokeyi.

tekrar.c: “Write the names of two individual sports and two team sports.” = İki {bireysel|kış} ve iki takım sporunun adını yaz.
“Individual Sports / Team Sports” = {Bireysel / Takım|Kapalı / Açık} sporlar
running, swimming, archery → {Individual|Team}
golf, karate, wrestling → {Individual|Team}
football, basketball, handball → {Team|Individual}
ice-hockey, baseball → {Team|Individual}

maddeler: Sıklık zarfları: always (her zaman) · usually (genellikle) · sometimes (bazen) · never (asla).
Kalıp: I + zarf + fiil + … Zarf fiilden önce gelir. (WB s. 86: before the main verb)
Ezber cümle 1: I usually do my homework after school.
Ezber cümle 2: I never go to bed late.
Kâğıttaki örneği (I always watch TV after school) kopyalama; kendi iki cümleni yaz.

hatalar.dogru: I usually do my homework. (zarf fiilden önce)

hatalar.yanlis: I never goes to bed late.
hatalar.dogru: I never go to bed late. (I ile -s yok)
Tam cümle: I usually do my homework after school.

tekrar.c: “Write two sentences about your daily routines.” = Günlük {rutinlerin|tatilin} hakkında iki cümle yaz.
“using frequency adverbs” = {sıklık zarflarını|renkleri} kullanarak
I {usually|usual} do my homework after school.
I never {go|goes} to bed late.
Zarf nerede? {I usually do|I do usually} my homework.
never = {asla|her zaman}, always = {her zaman|bazen}

formuller.kalip: Yes, he/she is. · No, he/she isn't. · Yes, they are.

formuller.ornek: I never go to bed late.

maddeler.soru: 1. Who is older, Jane or Sam?

iskele.aciklama: Tam cümle: Sam is older than Jane.
Tam cümle: Sam is taller than Jane.
Tam cümle: Sam is heavier than Jane.

metin: Part B. Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences. (24 points)

Hi, my name is Sam. I am fourteen years old. I am short and plump with dark, wavy hair and brown eyes. I like wearing colorful glasses. This is my young brother, Harry. He is younger than me. We don't look alike at all. He is a little taller than me, with curly blond hair and green eyes. He is well-built because he likes doing sports. Our personalities are very different as well. He has a lot of friends, and he gets along well with new people. I am usually shyer and more nervous than him. I have a few close friends. I am always on time; I don't like being late to meetings, but he is usually not punctual. We are both generous and kind people. We always share what we have and support each other. I love my brother.

iskele.aciklama: Tam cümle: Sam is shorter than Harry.

maddeler.kisaCevap: He is well-built with curly blond hair and green eyes.

b.cevap: He is well-built with curly blond hair and green eyes.

iskele.aciklama: Tam cümle: He is well-built with curly blond hair and green eyes.
Tam cümle: Harry is outgoing and social.

maddeler.kisaCevap: He is shy, nervous, punctual, generous and kind.

b.cevap: He is shy, nervous, punctual, generous and kind.

iskele.aciklama: Tam cümle: He is shy, nervous, punctual, generous and kind.
Tam cümle: Sam is older than Harry.

metin: Part C. Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences. (20 Points)

These are my friends: Ellie, Jenny, and Jeremy. We met in elementary school, so we know each other very well. Ellie doesn't change her mind easily. She is very stubborn but respectful and kind to others, so we don't mind that much. Jenny is more open-minded than Ellie, and she always tells the truth. She hates telling lies. Jeremy studies hard and always gets high marks. He loves learning new things. Me? I am Rosa. Unfortunately, I always drop and break things by accident. I always say “Thank you” and “Sorry” when I need to.

maddeler.kisaCevap: She is stubborn, respectful and kind.

b.cevap: She is stubborn, respectful and kind.

iskele.aciklama: Tam cümle: She is stubborn, respectful and kind.

maddeler.soru: 2. Who is honest and never tells lies?
maddeler.kisaCevap: Jenny is honest and never tells lies.

b.cevap: Jenny is honest and never tells lies.

iskele.aciklama: Tam cümle: Jenny is honest and never tells lies.

maddeler.soru: 5. Are Ellie and Rosa kind people?

metin: Part D. Sports & Vocabulary (Spor Kelimeleri) (20 points)
Kutudaki kelimeler: running, archery, football, golf, karate, swimming, basketball, handball, ice-hockey, baseball, wrestling

maddeler.soru: Write the names of two individual sports and two team sports.

iskele.soru: Kâğıttaki tablo gibi: her sporu doğru sütuna koy.
iskele.aciklama: Tek başına yapılanlar individual: running, archery, golf, karate, swimming, wrestling. Takımla oynananlar team: football, basketball, handball, ice-hockey, baseball.

maddeler.kisaCevap: Individual: swimming, running (archery, golf, karate, wrestling) · Team: football, basketball (handball, ice-hockey, baseball)

metin: Part E. (21 points) Soru 4: Writing about Routines (Frequency Adverbs)
Write two sentences about your daily routines using frequency adverbs (always, usually, sometimes, never).
Example: I always watch TV after school. / I always wake up early on weekdays.

maddeler.soru: Write two sentences about your daily routines.

iskele.soru: İki cümle yaz: I + zarf + fiil. (Ezber: I usually do my homework after school. / I never go to bed late.)

b.cevap: I usually do my homework after school.
I never go to bed late.

iskele.aciklama: I ile başlayıp bir sıklık zarfı (always, usually, sometimes, never) içeren anlamlı cümle doğru sayılır. Zarf fiilden önce gelir.

maddeler.kisaCevap: I usually do my homework after school. / I never go to bed late.

kuarkHata.soru: Who is older, Jane or Sam?
secenekler: Tam cümle olmalı: Sam is older than Jane.
Jane is older than Sam. olmalı.
kuarkHata.aciklama: Tam cümle: İsim + is + older + than + diğeri.

secenekler: “What is … like?” kişiliği sorar: He is shy, nervous, punctual, generous and kind.
He has got brown eyes. olmalı.
kuarkHata.aciklama: Kişilik: shy, nervous, punctual, generous, kind.
kuarkHata.dogruCevap: He is shy, nervous, punctual, generous and kind.

secenekler: Harry is a little taller than Sam → Sam is shorter than Harry.
kuarkHata.ipucu: “He is a little taller than me.” cümlesindeki “me” kim?

kuarkHata.ipucu: “Me? I am Rosa.” sonrasındaki cümleye bak.
kuarkHata.aciklama: drop and break things by accident = sakar (clumsy).
